M4a_method_note: The 256 per-decision MC samples of the v1.4.6 run were NOT retained (_rollout_mc_mean accumulates and returns only the mean), so partitioning them after the fact is impossible without editing the anchored predict.py. The same 256-sample budget is instead spent as two independent n=128 halves, giving the split-half floor DIRECTLY rather than by 1/sqrt(n) extrapolation, at no extra rollout cost over the ordered M4b.
caveats: n=256 traded decisions on ONE fixture-planted cell; point estimates, NOT significance claims; no paired CI computed on any difference.
